correctness.rationale: The candidate has precisely 57 integer affine intervals in the first 15M integers and 1640 exact component sum intervals. All ordering and integer-adjacency comparisons of the 3396 relevant affine endpoints have no crossing for real f>14, so exact disjoint/cover interval verification at f=15 and f=8,...,14 proves the greedy prefix for every f>=8. The candidate has four identical nonzero length-3M characteristic blocks, so the proven published four-block continuation theorem extends it indefinitely. An elementary three-unequal-exceptional-gap argument proves minimal period f+5, and a mismatched boundary gap proves minimal preperiod 2f+10. The standalone exact-integer checker reproduced its stated output; finite independent terms only corroborate.

value.rationale: This is a natural exact classification of the fourth off-diagonal family of an explicitly conjectured infinite greedy-periodicity problem. Unlike isolated finite evaluations or a routine deduction from conjectured period lengths, it supplies the full set of terms and proves both minimal period and minimal preperiod for unbounded f>=8 using a symbolic affine-interval certificate that establishes the required uniform continuation hypothesis. It does not resolve arbitrary initial seeds.
